ai_review_of_company_receipts_permitted: unknown - must be confirmed by an authorized company person
notes: assistant_read_labels = 'provisional_included': the 22 authentic labels read by the assistant are scored but every report labels them PROVISIONAL and not human-verified.

Set to 'excluded' (node scripts/set_label_policy.mjs --assistant-labels exclude) if company policy forbids AI review of the receipts: every assistant-read label is then withheld from scoring (its predictions still run, but nothing is scored) until an authorized human has relabelled it.
A label becomes human-verified only through scripts/apply_verification.mjs from a reviewer export with a reviewer id and authorization_confirmed = true. Nothing else may set it.
